card.name: Words just before 'placebo' in comparisons
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs such as received, to, with, on and of that sit right before the word placebo. They appear where a drug group is compared with a placebo group in trial results.

modes.label: Verb before placebo
modes.description: The verb received or receive leads into placebo in a patient-group comparison.
modes.example: approximately 13% of patients who received BRIVIACT (at least 50 mg/day) compared to 8% of patients who<< received>> placebo.

modes.label: Linking word before placebo
modes.description: Words like to, with, on or of come right before placebo after a drug percentage or a compared-to phrase.
modes.example: In controlled clinical trials the incidence of anemia was 0.6% with celecoxib and 0.4%<< with>> placebo.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting the word placebo next, though the listed tokens are not clearly related.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a trial comparison where the next word is expected to be placebo.
